verdict.rationale: Readable text was extracted from multiple public GST guidance pages, including the help modules, the registration help page, the homepage and the developer portal. That indicates these pages serve keyless HTML content. The companion probe explicitly contrasts the income-tax portal's JS-only app shell with "the GST portal's readable pages," which supports the absence of a JS shell wall on GST. missing for 10: a direct probe of gst.gov.in pages with an identified user agent (status code, byte count, content markers), and explicit confirmation that no CAPTCHA or bot challenge appears across the guidance surface, such as the linked manuals and FAQs.
